title: Drifter Bar Salts Blueberry & Cherry 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Blueberry and Cherry by Drifter Bar Salts blends two classic fruits into a rich, vibrant vape. The juicy sweetness of ripe Blueberries is layered with the bold, tangy character of Cherry, creating a mouth-watering fruit duo that’s full of depth and balance. Each puff delivers a sweet-yet-sharp flavour that lingers deliciously on the tastebuds. This nic salt e-liquid is crafted with a 50% PG / 50% VG blend, offering a smooth throat hit, rapid nicotine relief, and discreet vapour production. Available in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, it’s ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) and RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) vaping styles, especially when paired with low-powered pod kits and starter devices. Drifter Bar Salts are designed to capture the punchy, mouth-watering flavours of disposable vapes in a reusable e-liquid format, helping you enjoy your favourite blends while saving money and reducing waste. Why not try other incredible flavours from Drifter's Bar Salts and Bar Juice collections? From Blackcurrant Ice to Watermelon Strawberry Bubblegum, to Strawberry Raspberry Cherry and Lime Raspberry Cherry, whatever your taste in e-liquid, Drifter E-liquid has an incredible flavour waiting to light up your tastebuds.
